description: Optimize and convert a 3D model to GLTF using DGG RapidPipeline.
inputInstructions:
Optimizes and decimates a 3D model with RapidPipeline (Amazon ECS) and outputs glTF (.gltf). Requires a licensed RapidPipeline deployment. Select the source model as the input file.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata — optimization settings come from this template.
